content: NewsBlur: thumbs up/down classifiers on author/tag/title/text/URL/publisher; green=liked (Focus), red=disliked (hidden); priority chain: natural-language prompt classifiers > super dislike > thumbs up > thumbs down > feed score; matched elements color-highlighted with inline icons; Manage Training tab lists all training; NL classifiers backfill recent stories on save, match/no-match/opposite, ~0.1c/story, monthly spend cap; classifier pills shown in story header.
